agent_notes: The official website and campus identity are verified, but the official About page states 100+ UG, PG, Diploma and Research Programs while several linked faculties resolve to under-maintenance pages and no complete central catalogue was available. The record is therefore manual_review with partial_official_website catalogue status.

The accessible official pages expose a substantial programme subset, including current 2025-26/2026-27 programme and admission material. Durations and eligibility were left null where the official page did not explicitly state them.

The managed proxy returned the exact self-signed certificate-chain error on normal TLS requests. After confirming jrnrvu.edu.in as the expected official domain, --insecure was used only for public GET requests and this fallback is recorded here.
The Ph.D. Programme 2026-27 subject list is represented as one official multidisciplinary doctoral programme record with the exact subject list copied into specialization.
Several app career-tree mappings are nearest-parent or closest-specialization mappings because career_nodes does not contain exact nodes for all university disciplines.
